items.note: S2.1 states Lemma lem:scalar-motifs faithfully (y_S+x_S for arbitrary scratch, three stages giving (-Y_a,X_a), restoration) and its motivation gives the subtract/restore idea of rows 0-1 and 6-7. It omits the essential check that the net map (JV+RG)x is the identity (central coefficient |S cap T| mod 2 or (|S cap T|-1)/2, side wires cancelling the rest), and never gives the neighbour rule, h=100 or the triple indexing.

Invariant 'stored = D_v(logical)' held at sources, carried across edges by D_vD_u^{-1} and through gates by commuting with the common frame, giving D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}: this is the paper's argument at 804-817. The per-route corollary eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1} is not spelled out.

Statement matches the lemma: comparable labels, only central 3->4 edges decrease, each by h, L=Ich, sum of |Delta dim| = Wm-2N+2L, and L/N = 100/539, 101/539 < 1/2 (the orthonormal-basis clause for binary residuals appears only later, in S3.1.1). The derivation keeps the orthogonality of neighbouring triple lines, but the label table (A,B,P,Q), the residual table and the telescoping count (sources sum to N, sinks to Wm-N) that produces Wm-2N+2L are all missing: S2.3.2 only quotes the conclusion.

It states the endpoint identity M_sink(rho(w)) - M_source(w) = I_m, the shear H<-H+D on every role, and s_b = W_b m - N + 2L_b < W_b m. The method has the right ingredients (P_U at gates and sinks, -P_{U_a} at the X_a sources, rank = dimension change), but the endpoint computation P_{U_a^perp} + P_{U_a} = I is not shown. The source exception (2P_{U_a}, of rank one, on the N X_a sources) is loosely given as 'one per source', and the shear frames Phi_M are not defined here.

It gives the phase frames C_U, the one-kernel-per-orthonormal-residual-vector product and C^{tensor m} on every role after the corrections, all as inferences from the proposition. The defining count s_c = W_c m - 2N + 2L_c < W_c m is missing (s_c is only named, in S3.1.6), and q_U is never defined.

The bit chain L<N/2 => s_b<W_b m => s_b/W_b < m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50}, from a deficit above 20*2^{-50}, is present. The exact eta values are missing, and so is the step log m < 20 that turns the deficit into the exponent (1332-1338). On the complex side, s_c<W_c m and s_c/W_c<m^sigma appear only as a motivation (S3.3), with no value of sigma until S7.1.1.

The elementary operations and controlled shifts are stated, and the split-at-the-offset, merge-in-reverse-order route matches 577-581 for shifts. The condition that the offset be prepared in b^{O(1)} time (with denominators prime to q) appears only in the quote, not in the claim. Multiplication by a fixed unit is wrongly attributed to the same two-piece split; the paper uses c increasing pieces and a reversal for negation (592-614).

Factorization A=E_1 Pi E_2, the O(V) triangular transformations in descending order, and the one-interchange gadget for each 1 of Pi follow the paper (1425-1443). The elimination proof of the factorization (1375-1391) and the choice of a fixed odd prime q avoiding the denominators, so that the identities specialize mod q^b (1413-1423), are omitted. 'Invertible' is dropped from E_1, E_2.

It follows the proof step by step: cyclic row split into W streams of volume V/W with row count divisible by W^{k-1}, recursive pivot interchanges on b=e/m-digit fields, the merge undoing rho to give H<-H+D, the three-update interchange, s calls, F_k <= (s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), the geometric sum and the depth-first fixed-tape schedule. The frame identity with Phi_M is used only through 'relies on: frames'.

Rows from the chunks' own high digits, padding to W^k (R'<2R) and base-m pieces summing to O(Ve^tau) match 1660-1706. Missing: rho = O(log e) high digits, the exchange and rejoin of the high parts, and the conversion of binary u-bit ranges into radix-q digit ranges [q^e].

It has the conjugation by P_M into coordinate kernels, the inverse child via (-i)^f Z C Z, exactly s_c child calls on e/m axes and H_0^{tensor D} = b^D S_D C^{tensor D} S_D. The decomposition of P_M into a fixed number of binary row additions (1892-1901), which is what reduces the non-recursive work to row additions, and the endpoint Z_{a,f}/i^{27f} corrections are not stated within this derivation (S3's method names 'binary basis changes' only).

The route matches the paper: eight packed rotations flipping the parity and restoring w, a bad set bounded by delta_bad M from the excluded guard values, repair by sorting extracted records to destination ranks, and movement O(V(L^tau+1)) via chunk interchange. The statement gives only the simplified cost O(V(L^tau+1)), without the MA^3 and delta_bad terms or the parameter conditions under which they are absorbed (2001-2010), and no formula for delta_bad.

It states the recurrence F(e) <= (s/W)F(e/m) + O((eK)^tau + 1) with leaves O(e), the geometric O(e^lambda) internal sum and the base-m pieces giving O(d^{lambda'}). The constraint max{lambda, sigma + beta(1-sigma)} < lambda' < 1 is absent. Also missing: where the rows come from (the first q_0 chunks, padded to W^{k_0}), the bound K <= e^{c/beta} that makes the overhead O(e^lambda), and the leaf estimate e^sigma d^{beta(1-sigma)}.

Claim O(V d^{lambda'}) with exact Gaussian dyadic intermediates, guard Delta = ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}) = o(p), and final truncation error < sqrt2 2^{-p} via absolute row sums one: all correct. The guard derivation states A(e) <= sA(e/m)+E and the depth-ell value bound, but skips unrolling the depth recurrence (B^{k+1} <= B^2 d^nu, piece concatenation) that yields the polynomial d^{C_1}.

It follows the paper: character cancellation giving F^+F^- = t^{-1}I, decimation in frequency, bit-reversed stored order (B_t F_t^-, F_t^+ B_t^{-1}), then the layout cost components dK, pK^{tau-1}, ell d^{lambda'} and the error sqrt2 ell 2^{-p}. The layout permutation L is named only later (S5.3).
Evaluation at B_0 = 2^{4p}, four products of absolute values, |h_j| < B_0/2, centred-residue recovery and reduction mod y^r+1 all match the proof. Cost O(rp log(rp)).
The convolution rule, LB permuting records so that the stored order cancels, the error sqrt2 M(3ell+1)2^{-p} after exact scaling by M, and M=T/r pointwise products all follow 3414-3495.

Lemma lem:no-sort-resampling and the tensor form are stated correctly (P_s F_s = 2^{2 alpha^2} B_0 P_t F_t A, error < p^2, time O(t p^{3/2+delta} alpha), RF_s = 2^gamma B_0 Q F_t A, linewise cost, axis exposure by adjacent interchanges). The one-dimensional construction (3576-3792) is not derived, and gamma = 2d alpha^2 is not given.

It states Q F_t u = abar.(a*(abar.u))/T and the cancellation R F_s^+[(RF_s u)(RF_s v)] = u*v/S^2, via t_i being a unit mod s_i and the convolution rule. The chirp a_j = exp(-pi i sum s_i j_i^2/t_i) is never defined, and the Bluestein coefficient computation is only quoted, not shown.

Sizes, prime intervals and T/2<S<T are correct. The fixed-parameter list omits lambda, c and lambda'. alpha, gamma and eta = 1/(4d), and the gamma = o(b) bound used later, are missing, and the prime-existence argument is only named.

Isomorphism and convolution preservation, the triangular digit formula, updates in order i=d..1 and the O(Tp d^2(1+ell^tau)) layout cost follow the paper. mu_i = P_i^{-1} mod s_i and the prefix products P_i are used but never defined.

The twist x_d -> zeta y with zeta = e^{pi i/r}, its well-definedness and the wrap check zeta^{k+l}(-1)^h = zeta^j match 4303-4320. The M_C = D_- iota^{-1} M_r(...) interface formula and the twist errors are not given.

Source transform with exact counterpart RF_s and the six algorithm steps, including the two roles of S, match the paper. The input scaling 2^{-b-2} and the conjugation definition of F~^+ are not stated.

The error chain E_ring < 5TL, chirp < 8TL, E_s = 9 2^gamma TL, E_w < 28 2^gamma T^2 L, the final < 448b 2^{-3b/4} < 1/2, rounding and bounded carries are all as in the paper. The use of gamma <= b/4 is implicit.
Table rows, margins, min g_i = 2^{-181} = 2kappa, o(Tp) setup, deterministic sorting bound, polylog absorption and the schoolbook cutoff all reproduce the paper's accounting.
No step states why the bound refutes an eventual n lg n lower bound (liminf T_A(n)/(n lg n) = 0). S0 only lists 'nlogn-conjecture' among its relies-on tags, so it is treated conservatively as absent.

errors.says: Multiplying a later field by a fixed unit modulo q^b costs O(V) by splitting the fiber at the offset and merging the two pieces in the opposite order.
errors.paper: The two-piece split at Q-a is the method for adding an offset. Multiplication by c is done by splitting each fiber into c increasing pieces classified by floor(cy/Q) and merging by a residue counter, and negation by a stack reversal.

errors.says: Sum the edge ranks as label-dimension changes plus one per source.
errors.paper: Only the N sources X_a, carrying -P_{U_a}, are exceptions: their first edge matrix is 2P_{U_a}, of rank one, where the dimension change is zero. Every other source has the zero matrix and contributes no extra rank.

errors.says: The packed selected-bit addition costs O(V(L^tau+1)).
errors.paper: The lemma's bound is O(V(L^tau+1) + M A^3 + delta_bad M A (R+A)). It reduces to O(V(L^tau+1)) only when A=O(p), R exceeds every fixed polynomial in p, f <= d <= p and K/log p -> infinity.

chain: The tree reaches the main bound by the paper's route: streams, the bank-exchange network, frames, labels, the bit interface, the matrix shear and the interchange recurrence (S2); the phase-frame layer recursion with packed row additions and guard bits (S3); then transforms, convolution, resampling with retained permutations, CRT, twist, exact recovery and the cost table (S4-S8). It thins out in the derivations behind the saving: the scalar network's net-identity check, the label tables and the telescoping count that gives Wm-2N+2L, the endpoint projection calculation, and the log m < 20 step are all quoted rather than shown. The complex side carries s_c only as a name.

steps.note: The plan gives the gate types, the exchange (X_a,Y_a) -> (-Y_a,X_a) and the restoration of scratch wires. It never gives h=100, the indexing of the data pairs by triples, N = C(h,3)^3 or m = h^3. Since most of the defining content is missing, it is rated conservatively.
It has the common frame commuting with the pointwise gate, the implemented operator D_out S D_in^{-1}, and the point that only the edge changes D_vD_u^{-1} have to be paid for.

Nondegenerate subspaces of an m-dimensional space built from tensor products of triple-indicator lines, comparable labels on every edge, and only central 3->4 edges decreasing, each by h. F^{tensor 3} is not written explicitly.

S2.4's motivation says the projection differences have rank equal to the label-dimension change, and its method adds one rank per source. The exception is loosely phrased: only the N X_a sources contribute, via 2P_{U_a}.
Both sum |Delta dim| = Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, and s_b = W_b m - N + 2L_b, are stated.
L/N = 100/539 and 101/539, both below 1/2, hence s < Wm. The deficit N-2L > 0 is implied rather than written.
M_sink(rho(w)) - M_source(w) = I_m on every input role, so the network applies the shear H<-H+D. The endpoint computation itself is not shown.
A = E_1 Pi E_2 with exactly rank(A) interchanges plus O(V), and a total of exactly s recursive calls per node.
Children of volume V/W, F_k <= (s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), s/W < m^tau with tau = 1-2^{-50} from a deficit above 20*2^{-50}, and F_k = O(e^tau). The log m < 20 step is omitted.

central.summary: The plan carries the central saving almost completely: frames, nested labels with the single decreasing central edge, rank = dimension change, the budget Wm-2N+2L, L/N < 1/2 giving s<Wm, the endpoint identity giving the shear, rank-many recursive interchanges, and the recurrence with tau = 1-2^{-50}. The weak point is the fixed network itself, whose sizes (h=100, triple indexing, N, m) are never given. Smaller gaps are the loose 'one per source' rank exception and the omitted log m < 20.
